stem: Why were people like those shown in this image hopeful about their future?
instruction: Study the image and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: Nativism and Social Darwinism were expanding in American cities.

options.label: B
options.text: The U.S. social security system provided financial and medical benefits.

options.label: C
options.text: There were many jobs and business opportunities in America.

options.label: D
options.text: American cities had large and comfortable tenement apartment buildings.
